_comment: OAuth credentials per provider — empty schema scaffold. Populated when an operator runs `picoclaw auth login <provider>` inside the tenant container, OR auto-copied at provision time from /etc/picoclaw/shared-auth.json (or $PICOCLAW_SHARED_AUTH_PATH) on the controlplane host. The 'providers' object holds one key per provider; the exact sub-shape is owned by each provider's auth flow.

codex._hint: After `picoclaw auth login codex`, this gets {access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, account_id, ...}. Leave the parent object present even when empty so the launcher's auth subsystem finds the right shape.

claude_cli._hint: Same flow as codex — `picoclaw auth login claude-cli` populates {access_token, refresh_token, organization_id}.

github._hint: OAuth device flow via `picoclaw auth login github` writes {access_token, token_type, scope}. Used by the github skill family.
